Motion.metaDescription: How this site moves: the motion tokens and the 11 transitions (T1–T11), playable one by one, with their internals and a technical note.
Motion.title: Motion
Motion.intro: Everything that moves in this portfolio comes from a few tokens and 11 transitions. Here you can see them one by one: play them, slow them down and look inside at the mask or render target each one uses. Every demo runs the same code as the site.

tokens.intro: A single source of values: what you see here comes from `motion/tokens.ts`, the same file the site's animations use.
